themes.title: Local and Regional Dynamics in Right-Wing Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing political actors are leveraging local governance and regional policy battles to solidify their political base and counter administrative authorities. In both the United States and Norway, local party figures are actively challenging regional leadership decisions and focusing on municipal-level influence across law enforcement, education, and judicial appointments.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Emphasis on local judicial appointments, regional campaign pushes in North Carolina, and local police involvement in federal enforcement.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local elected representatives defy county administration to protect regional vocational building trades programs.
